description: This file defines the DataRegistrationUtility class responsible for handling registration data collection, preparation, and transmission during installation or upgrade processes in the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes other internal utilities like SystemConfiguration and DataRegistrationService to execute its functions.

classes.name: DataRegistrationUtility
classes.description: A utility class for managing registration data during system installation and upgrade, including gathering system info, preparing registration payloads, and sending registration data to a remote server.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves initial registration data from system configuration and prepares an array including organization and admin details along with an instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstallerInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Fetches registration data from session state containers for installer scenarios, returning an array of install-specific registration info.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Prepares the registration data payload for transmission, selecting between installer or upgrader data based on unique identifier presence.

methods.name: getSuccessRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Constructs the data payload to confirm successful registration for reporting.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates and stores a unique instance identifier based on admin and organization data, if not already set, and returns it.

methods.name: sendRegistrationDataOnSuccess
methods.description: Sends registration success data to a remote server and logs the event.
